content: In the unshakeable presence of non-violence, all surrounding hostility naturally ceases.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Ahimsa-pratishthayam tat-sannidhau vaira-tyagah (अहिंसाप्रतिष्ठायां तत्सन्निधौ वैरत्यागः) — Yoga Sutras II.35
explanation: Non-violence is not passive meekness; it is an immense, radiant spiritual gravitational field. When a person completely purges malice, defensiveness, and wrath from their nervous system, even wild predators and bitter adversaries feel their hostility melt in their presence.
practicalInsight: Purge all passive-aggressive jabs and sharp thoughts from your demeanor today. Radiate unconditional safety to those around you.
reflectionPrompt: What subtle violence—in tone, eye-rolls, or internal judgment—are you broadcasting into your daily environment?
